```{r highlight_numbers}
# TODO (team): replace with the real headline numbers (generated here, not typed)
gap_table =
  hospital_medians |>
  filter(n_stays >= min_cases) |>
  group_by(condition) |>
  summarize(p90_p10 = quantile(median_charges, 0.9) / quantile(median_charges, 0.1))

headline_gap = round(max(gap_table$p90_p10), 1)

headline_markup =
  hospital_medians |>
  filter(n_stays >= min_cases) |>
  summarize(markup = median(markup)) |>
  pull(markup) |>
  round(1)

headline_adjusted =
  hospital_adjusted |>
  summarize(p90_p10 = quantile(adjusted_ratio, 0.9) / quantile(adjusted_ratio, 0.1)) |>
  pull(p90_p10) |>
  round(1)

headline_consistent =
  hospital_medians |>
  filter(n_stays >= min_cases) |>
  group_by(condition) |>
  mutate(top_quarter = median_charges >= quantile(median_charges, 0.75)) |>
  group_by(hosp_id) |>
  summarize(n_conditions = n(), n_top = sum(top_quarter)) |>
  filter(n_conditions == 5, n_top == 5) |>
  nrow()
```

<!-- =====================  4. Question 1  ===================== -->

::::: {.screen .scrolly-intro data-bg="q1"}

[Question 1]{.eyebrow}

## How far apart are hospitals?

[We take one condition at a time and compare the typical bill at each hospital.]{.lede}

:::::

```{r q1_chart_data}
# TODO (team): the dots are simulated. Use the real Q1 output for one condition.
chart_left = 30
chart_right = 730
chart_top = 40
chart_bottom = 450

q1_hospitals =
  hospital_medians |>
  filter(condition == "Heart failure", n_stays >= min_cases) |>
  slice_sample(n = 70) |>
  mutate(
    id = row_number(),
    rank_charges = min_rank(desc(median_charges)),
    grp = case_when(
      rank_charges <= 5 ~ "high",
      rank_charges > n() - 5 ~ "low",
      TRUE ~ "mid"
    ),
    label = str_c(facility_name, ": ", scales::label_dollar(accuracy = 1)(median_charges)),
    y_cloud = runif(n(), min = chart_top + 30, max = chart_bottom - 30),
    y_rank = chart_top + (rank_charges - 1) / (n() - 1) * (chart_bottom - chart_top)
  )

dollar_range = range(log(c(q1_hospitals$median_charges, q1_hospitals$median_costs)))

x_dollar = function(v) {
  chart_left + (log(v) - dollar_range[1]) / (dollar_range[2] - dollar_range[1]) * (chart_right - chart_left)
}

q1_state = function(data, state, x_col, y_col, highlight) {
  data |>
    transmute(
      id, label, shape = "circle", r = 5.5, w = NA, h = NA,
      state = state,
      x = x_dollar({{ x_col }}),
      y = {{ y_col }},
      fill = case_when(
        highlight & grp == "high" ~ site_high,
        highlight & grp == "low" ~ site_teal,
        TRUE ~ site_ink
      ),
      o = if_else(highlight & grp == "mid", 0.16, 0.8)
    )
}

q1_marks =
  bind_rows(
    q1_state(q1_hospitals, 0, median_charges, y_cloud, FALSE),
    q1_state(q1_hospitals, 1, median_charges, y_rank, FALSE),
    q1_state(q1_hospitals, 2, median_charges, y_rank, TRUE),
    q1_state(q1_hospitals, 3, median_costs, y_rank, TRUE)
  )

dollar_ticks =
  tibble(value = c(2500, 5000, 10000, 20000, 40000, 80000, 160000)) |>
  mutate(x = x_dollar(value)) |>
  filter(x >= chart_left, x <= chart_right)

dollar_axis = function(title) {
  bind_rows(
    dollar_ticks |>
      transmute(x, y = chart_bottom + 28, text = scales::label_dollar()(value), anchor = "middle", strong = FALSE),
    tibble(x = (chart_left + chart_right) / 2, y = chart_bottom + 58, text = title, anchor = "middle", strong = TRUE)
  )
}

dollar_guides = dollar_ticks |> transmute(x1 = x, y1 = chart_top - 10, x2 = x, y2 = chart_bottom + 10)

q1_gap = max(q1_hospitals$median_charges) / min(q1_hospitals$median_charges)
q1_cost_gap = max(q1_hospitals$median_costs) / min(q1_hospitals$median_costs)

q1_states =
  tibble(
    readout = c(
      str_c(nrow(q1_hospitals), " hospitals · heart failure · simulated"),
      "Ranked from the highest median charge to the lowest",
      str_c("Highest ÷ lowest median charge: ", round(q1_gap, 1), "×"),
      str_c("Highest ÷ lowest estimated cost: ", round(q1_cost_gap, 1), "×")
    ),
    labels = list(
      dollar_axis("Median charge per stay (log scale)"),
      dollar_axis("Median charge per stay (log scale)"),
      dollar_axis("Median charge per stay (log scale)"),
      dollar_axis("Median estimated cost per stay (log scale)")
    ),
    guides = list(dollar_guides, dollar_guides, dollar_guides, dollar_guides)
  )
```

::::: {.scrolly data-bg="q1"}

:::: {.scrolly-graphic}
<svg class="scrolly-chart" viewBox="0 0 760 520" role="img" aria-label="Hospital median charges for heart failure, simulated data"></svg>
<div class="scrolly-readout"></div>
```{r q1_chart_json, results = "asis"}
scrolly_script(q1_marks, q1_states)
```
::::

:::: {.scrolly-steps}

::: {.step}
[01]{.step-n}

### One dot, one hospital.

Each dot sits at the typical bill for the same condition at one hospital. `r demo_badge`
:::

::: {.step}
[02]{.step-n}

### Line them up.

From the most expensive hospital at the top to the least expensive at the bottom.
:::

::: {.step}
[03]{.step-n}

### The two ends.

The five highest and the five lowest. The distance between them is the gap we are measuring.
:::

::: {.step}
[04]{.step-n}

### Now look at costs.

The same hospitals, in the same order, placed by the state's estimate of what the stay cost them. [See the full Question 1 analysis →](q1_gaps.html)
:::

<!-- =====================  5. Question 2  ===================== -->

::::: {.screen .scrolly-intro data-bg="q2"}

[Question 2]{.eyebrow}

## What changes once we account for patients?

[Hospitals treat different patients. We compare them again after adjusting for severity of illness, age group and length of stay.]{.lede}

:::::

```{r q2_chart_data}
# TODO (team): simulated. Use the hospital effects from the Q2 models.
ratio_limits = log(c(0.3, 3.3))

x_ratio = function(v) {
  chart_left + (log(v) - ratio_limits[1]) / (ratio_limits[2] - ratio_limits[1]) * (chart_right - chart_left)
}

q2_hospitals =
  hospital_adjusted |>
  filter(condition == "Heart failure") |>
  left_join(hospital_medians |> distinct(hosp_id, facility_name), by = "hosp_id") |>
  slice_sample(n = 70) |>
  mutate(
    id = row_number(),
    across(c(unadjusted_ratio, adjusted_ratio), \(v) pmin(pmax(v, 0.32), 3.1)),
    label = facility_name,
    closer = abs(log(adjusted_ratio)) < abs(log(unadjusted_ratio)),
    y_unadjusted = chart_top + (min_rank(desc(unadjusted_ratio)) - 1) / (n() - 1) * (chart_bottom - chart_top),
    y_adjusted = chart_top + (min_rank(desc(adjusted_ratio)) - 1) / (n() - 1) * (chart_bottom - chart_top)
  )

q2_state = function(data, state, x_col, y_col, coloured) {
  data |>
    transmute(
      id, label, shape = "circle", r = 5.5, w = NA, h = NA,
      state = state,
      x = x_ratio({{ x_col }}),
      y = {{ y_col }},
      fill = case_when(
        coloured & closer ~ site_teal,
        coloured & !closer ~ site_high,
        TRUE ~ site_ink
      ),
      o = 0.85
    )
}

q2_marks =
  bind_rows(
    q2_state(q2_hospitals, 0, unadjusted_ratio, y_unadjusted, FALSE),
    q2_state(q2_hospitals, 1, adjusted_ratio, y_unadjusted, TRUE),
    q2_state(q2_hospitals, 2, adjusted_ratio, y_adjusted, TRUE)
  )

ratio_ticks = tibble(value = c(0.5, 0.75, 1, 1.5, 2, 3)) |> mutate(x = x_ratio(value))

ratio_axis = function(title) {
  bind_rows(
    ratio_ticks |>
      transmute(x, y = chart_bottom + 28, text = str_c(value, "×"), anchor = "middle", strong = value == 1),
    tibble(x = (chart_left + chart_right) / 2, y = chart_bottom + 58, text = title, anchor = "middle", strong = TRUE)
  )
}

ratio_guides = ratio_ticks |> transmute(x1 = x, y1 = chart_top - 10, x2 = x, y2 = chart_bottom + 10)

spread = function(v) round(quantile(v, 0.9) / quantile(v, 0.1), 1)

q2_states =
  tibble(
    readout = c(
      str_c("Before adjustment · 90th ÷ 10th percentile: ", spread(q2_hospitals$unadjusted_ratio), "×"),
      "Teal moved closer to the typical hospital; navy moved further away",
      str_c("After adjustment · 90th ÷ 10th percentile: ", spread(q2_hospitals$adjusted_ratio), "×")
    ),
    labels = list(
      ratio_axis("Charges relative to the typical hospital, unadjusted"),
      ratio_axis("Charges relative to the typical hospital, adjusted"),
      ratio_axis("Charges relative to the typical hospital, adjusted")
    ),
    guides = list(ratio_guides, ratio_guides, ratio_guides)
  )
```

::::: {.scrolly data-bg="q2"}

:::: {.scrolly-graphic}
<svg class="scrolly-chart" viewBox="0 0 760 520" role="img" aria-label="Hospital differences before and after adjustment, simulated data"></svg>
<div class="scrolly-readout"></div>
```{r q2_chart_json, results = "asis"}
scrolly_script(q2_marks, q2_states)
```
::::

:::: {.scrolly-steps}

::: {.step}
[01]{.step-n}

### Before.

Each hospital compared with the typical hospital, using raw charges. `r demo_badge`
:::

::: {.step}
[02]{.step-n}

### Same patients, same yardstick.

Each dot slides to where the hospital sits once severity, age and length of stay are held equal. Some move toward the middle. Some move away.
:::

::: {.step}
[03]{.step-n}

### After.

Re-ranked on the adjusted comparison. What is left is the difference patients do not explain. [See the full Question 2 analysis →](q2_adjusted.html)
:::

<!-- =====================  6. Question 3  ===================== -->

::::: {.screen .scrolly-intro data-bg="q3"}

[Question 3]{.eyebrow}

## Is an expensive hospital expensive for everything?

[One row per hospital, one column per condition. Darker cells are above the state median, lighter cells are below, grey means too few cases to say.]{.lede}

:::::

```{r q3_chart_data}
# TODO (team): simulated. Use data/hospital_consistency.csv from the Q3 analysis.
grid_left = 190
cell_w = 104
cell_gap = 6
cell_h = 15
row_gap = 3.5
grid_top = 56
n_rows = 22

q3_cells =
  hospital_medians |>
  group_by(condition) |>
  mutate(ratio = median_charges / median(median_charges[n_stays >= min_cases])) |>
  ungroup() |>
  filter(hosp_id %in% sample(unique(hosp_id), n_rows)) |>
  complete(nesting(hosp_id, facility_name), condition) |>
  mutate(
    enough = !is.na(n_stays) & n_stays >= min_cases,
    fill = if_else(enough, ratio_colour(ratio), site_grey_cell),
    label = if_else(
      enough,
      str_c(facility_name, " · ", condition, ": ", round(ratio, 2), "× the state median"),
      str_c(facility_name, " · ", condition, ": too few cases")
    )
  ) |>
  group_by(hosp_id) |>
  mutate(mean_log_ratio = mean(log(ratio[enough]))) |>
  ungroup() |>
  mutate(
    row_random = dense_rank(hosp_id * 7919 %% 101 + hosp_id / 1e5),
    row_sorted = dense_rank(desc(mean_log_ratio) + hosp_id / 1e9),
    col = as.integer(condition),
    id = row_number()
  )

focus_row = 9

row_y = function(row) grid_top + (row - 1) * (cell_h + row_gap)

q3_state = function(data, state, row_col, focus_only) {
  data |>
    transmute(
      id, label, shape = "rect", r = NA, w = cell_w, h = cell_h,
      state = state,
      x = grid_left + (col - 1) * (cell_w + cell_gap),
      y = row_y({{ row_col }}),
      fill,
      o = if_else(focus_only & row_random != focus_row, 0.1, 1)
    )
}

q3_marks =
  bind_rows(
    q3_state(q3_cells, 0, row_random, TRUE),
    q3_state(q3_cells, 1, row_random, FALSE),
    q3_state(q3_cells, 2, row_sorted, FALSE)
  )

column_labels =
  tibble(
    x = grid_left + (seq_along(condition_levels) - 1) * (cell_w + cell_gap) + cell_w / 2,
    y = grid_top - 16,
    text = c("Heart failure", "Respiratory", "Kidney/UTI", "Stroke", "Sepsis"),
    anchor = "middle",
    strong = TRUE
  )

legend_label =
  tibble(
    x = grid_left + 2.5 * (cell_w + cell_gap) - cell_gap / 2,
    y = row_y(n_rows) + cell_h + 30,
    text = "light: below the state median · dark: above · grey: fewer than 30 stays",
    anchor = "middle",
    strong = FALSE
  )

side_label = function(row, text) {
  tibble(x = grid_left - 14, y = row_y(row) + cell_h - 3, text = text, anchor = "end", strong = FALSE)
}

q3_states =
  tibble(
    readout = c(
      "One hospital, five conditions · simulated",
      str_c(n_rows, " hospitals, in no particular order"),
      "Sorted by how expensive each hospital is on average"
    ),
    labels = list(
      bind_rows(column_labels, legend_label, side_label(focus_row, "One hospital")),
      bind_rows(column_labels, legend_label),
      bind_rows(column_labels, legend_label, side_label(1, "High across the board"), side_label(n_rows, "Low across the board"))
    ),
    guides = list(tibble(), tibble(), tibble())
  )
```

::::: {.scrolly data-bg="q3"}

:::: {.scrolly-graphic}
<svg class="scrolly-chart" viewBox="0 0 760 520" role="img" aria-label="Hospitals by condition heatmap, simulated data"></svg>
<div class="scrolly-readout"></div>
```{r q3_chart_json, results = "asis"}
scrolly_script(q3_marks, q3_states)
```
::::

:::: {.scrolly-steps}

::: {.step}
[01]{.step-n}

### One hospital, five bills.

Read across the row: is this hospital above or below the state median for each condition? `r demo_badge`
:::

::: {.step}
[02]{.step-n}

### Every hospital.

In no particular order, the picture looks like noise.
:::

::: {.step}
[03]{.step-n}

### Sorted.

Put the most expensive hospitals at the top. Rows that stay dark or stay light all the way across are consistently high or consistently low. [See the full Question 3 analysis →](q3_consistency.html)
:::

## Read, reproduce, reuse.
